climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A valley AVA north of Clear Lake in Lake County, set 1,326 to 2,820 feet up among valleys south of the Mendocino National Forest. It started with 16 vineyards on about 300 acres. The county's main grapes are Cabernet Sauvignon and Sauvignon Blanc.
